root_cause: Supabase migration-history parity recovery was routed through a Netlify production marker because GitHub control-plane files participated in runtime lane classification and the terminalizer treated every non-governance change as Netlify-hosted runtime.
prevention: .github/** is governance-only for runtime lane classification.
Bounded Supabase migration-history recovery is runtime-not-applicable only when its non-governance scope is limited to canonical parity-recovery surfaces.
Non-Netlify runtime without a dedicated production readback fails closed with UNWIRED_NON_NETLIFY_RUNTIME_READBACK.
Terminal evidence records readback_mode and cannot claim deployment readback when it was not performed.

evidence.observed_blocker: production-readback waited for exact Netlify release identity although the obligation was Supabase migration-history parity recovery
